name: Harahar Jihua
source:
Plan Harahar is a poetic love letter, and also a short visual prose novella. It is, noticeably, asexual. It contains no name, no sprite, and no word “love”.

[From [url=https://klke.itch.io/harahar]Itch.io[/url]]
